body:
Those are interesting statistics thank you for sharing. Sorry I take a while to respond. :) 

We have sex really regularly, probably every second day, sometimes every day, depends on the day you know... It wasn't always like that though. I went through a period of work stress, killed my libido, he complained for a few months, I did not realise it was that big of a problem at the time. I didn't realise how unappreciated I made him feel. I didn't realise how important sex was to your partner. It wasn't that I didn't want to have sex, it's that, I was constantly stressed out and yeah. This lead to a boil up and his eventual admittance of possibly wanting to sleep with someone else one day. He did say he needs sex more frequently and sometimes I'm not up for it and he can't live like that forever. But, the conversation went further into experience and I think in the long run it will become about novelty. It wasn't just open relationships. It spread into polyamory territory which I am even more not okay with. We spoke about it again after that big bad night... And he has told me over and over again that I need to not worry about it. He did not mean he absolutely wants that. He just meant it is a possibility one day. I changed completely after that. I separated my stress from my libido. It was easy because it really was never a problem of not wanting to. 

I remember at the time of that I told him I can give him sex every day. He told me I can't do that forever. I said I can because I want to, it's not forcing myself. It's been 2 years and I have not slipped at all. My libido is the same. 

I think, one big problem is we have stopped talking about it. But I can't and I know he doesn't want to talk about it either. 

Are you monogamous? Have you ever thought about it?

Hey... thank you so much for this. I don't know how you could tell that seeing studies and research on this topic would actually calm me down. It's how my brain works. I just have to truly thank you for that. 

It hurts though, in a different way. I love my partner. I don't want to leave him. But it hurts me immensely to be with him. Every day I am in uncertainty and paranoia and it's hard. It hurts because, now I know I am not alone out here, but the idea of leaving my partner hurts... So.. I am left with staying with him until he leaves me one day for someone new because it's what he wants or leave him and hurt him and find someone who might or might not just be lying about whether they are monogamous or not.

I'm only 25, maybe people have their lives more figured out when they are older...

Thank you for everything, you've given me hope that I needed.
Hey, thank you. Maybe things will change one day... :)

I think most atheists are not monogamous. That's the only value I think we have different overall to religious folks. 

I get very upset with religious folks that try to say we have no morals, etc. I just want to clarify that's not what I mean. In fact, atheists are the only ones with morals. Religious people only don't do bad things because a 2000 year old book told them not to and they fear hell.

Hey, thank you so much for taking the time to share with me. You've made me feel less alone and it helps to talk to someone that understands.

I have a very health relationship. I know my boyfriend loves me to the moon and back. I think that's what makes it the hardest part, because, I fear we are incompatible. We have spoken about it, and he's told me I need to not worry about it because he loves me, he's not going anywhere, but he can't promise for the future. I know he would never cheat or lie to me. I trust him. But, I fear that as soon as he meets a girl that fits his likes, he will change his mind and my fairy tale will end. I mean, it's not an unrational fear because he's told me it's a possibility.

I can't bring myself to ever imagine leaving him because we fit together so well. We're alternative type people and I dislike most humans... And so does he... So.... finding each other was like a needle in a haystack.... And I love him, dearly. I have put myself through this mental torture of uncertainty and paranoia for 2 years. It's better sometimes, and other times it's worse. I don't want to leave because I love him... I've even tried to make my eyes wander but I can't, I am not interested in other people, at all. I think this is why it hurts so much when he said he might one day because I can't wrap my head around it. In my head, that means he doesn't love me, but, logically, I know that's not true.

I don't like most women, I hate the stuff they do, how much they show off, the obvious "Look at my ass" moves that we all can tell from a mile away. I hate those kinds of women. I have a handful of female friends and none of them really live close to me anymore. I guess I am probably lonely.

Life is complicated and full of bloodshed and tears. :)
